name: clumoove
tagline: Multi-cloud migration across 15 providers with hash-verified transfers
description: clumoove is a multi-cloud migration tool that moves data between 15 providers — Nextcloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, S3, and SFTP among them. It verifies each transfer with a three-way hash check to guard against silent corruption, and features multi-tenancy with TOTP support, so it can serve multiple users safely. It is written in Go and aimed at anyone who needs dependable, verified data portability across cloud and self-hosted storage.
highlights: Migrates across 15 providers including Nextcloud, Dropbox, GDrive, S3, SFTP
Three-way hash verification against silent corruption
curatorNote: Cloud migration tools tend to be tied to one provider. Hash-verified moves across 15 providers with multi-tenancy is a genuinely useful gap to fill for self-hosters.
